global_identity.color_palette: the colors of the product's packaging
global_identity.text_typography: a heavy bold sans for the headline in ALL CAPS, a clean sans for the rest

visual_prompt:
PRODUCT: VITALDROPS. Its bottle reproduced with total fidelity to the attached photo (label, brand name letter by letter, colors).
LAYOUT (question and answer): Z1 is the pain-question at the top; right below, the short answer inside a highlighted box; the product bottle BIG; then Z3, Z5 and Z6.
MODEL: a 50 years old woman, short and curvy, honey-brown skin, long straight black hair, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup. Emotion: Estudiante que trabaja, en la cafetería de la universidad al mediodía, con el almuerzo a medio comer. Primero cara de duda; luego media sonrisa de quien entendió qué le faltaba..
SETTING: a bathroom with a large mirror, warm light. POSE AND FRAMING: walking towards the camera, full body framing.

text_layers.text_style: very bold, ALL CAPS, high contrast, the biggest text

text_layers.reference_position: right below the question, in a highlighted box
text_layers.text_style: bold, in a box of the palette

text_layers.reference_position: on or next to the bottle
inside or right below the offer

mandatory_visual_elements: the real product from the attached product photo, at least 15% of the image
the woman: a 50 years old woman, short and curvy, honey-brown skin, long straight black hair, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup
final_generation_exclusions: any text closer than 5% to the edges
medical claims, guarantees or invented numbers
brands or logos other than the product

forbidden_additions: prices other than the given offer

language_rule: All visible text in Colombian Spanish, simple, perfectly spelled.
